The Business Playbook Series / 01

The Customer Friction Playbook

A Practical System for Finding, Prioritising and Fixing the Barriers That Stop Customers From Buying, Staying and Returning

By Timothy Madu · First edition

Customer experience

Every customer journey involves a sequence of decisions and actions. This playbook focuses on understanding where those actions become unnecessarily difficult and what a business can do about it.

Work through a structured improvement sequence: MAP, DETECT, DIAGNOSE, PRIORITISE, REDESIGN and MEASURE. Keep the focus on the cause of a problem and the evidence needed to assess the result.

What you will explore

Key takeaways.

  • Map the steps customers need to take.
  • Investigate the causes of friction before choosing a fix.
  • Prioritise improvements and check what changes achieve.
About the author

Timothy Madu

Timothy Madu is a business owner, entrepreneur and author based in Yenagoa, Bayelsa State, Nigeria. He owns KC TIMO AUTOMOBILES. His Business Playbook Series focuses on practical questions about customer experience, revenue opportunities and business improvement.
